pairs.subject: machine-authored-documentation
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/harness/route.ts:178 The harness route hands out the machine-authored build guide (assembled from the executor LLM's self-reported features, decisions and learnings, and billed as 'the ultimate deliverable') as finished markdown, with no semantic, structural or human-read result and no 'accepted (2 of 3 gates)' wording, so a reader gets a document with no receipt that it was ever accepted.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/harness/route.ts:178 The guide is served without any document-level gate result. The per-step build verification is about the UE build, not about whether the guide is admissible, and no review field exists, skipped or otherwise.

src/lib/harness/guide-generator.ts:110 The header names the generator but has no negative clause. Steps backed by verification gates and LLM-asserted 'Accumulated Learnings'/gotchas (guide-generator.ts:81-82) sit side by side with nothing saying which are grounded, which is the partial-grounding case this technique names.

pairs.subject: machine-authored-documentation
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/verify/visual/route.ts:7 Neither file in this context makes or accepts a model-authored document. One is a VLM verdict on a game screenshot and the other (baselineStore.ts:27) holds per-entity balance baselines. A search of src/stores and src/app/api/verify/visual for runbook, renderGuideMarkdown, guide.md, 'architecture map' and 'generated doc' found no hits.
